learning_rate_bound.interpretation: common conservative RAdamW first-two-unrectified-step scale bound; must still pass the predeclared two-step measured update/objective stability gate for every tau; halve this one common LR and repeat all six checks if the 0.01 relative delta cap fails

nash_reconstruction_checks.note: The per-row nash_mtl direction is recomputed by the repository aggregator from the pinned NPZ inputs for every tau/mode call; existing survey Nash rows are retained as the prior reference and row identity is independently verified.

two_rank_engineering.purpose: Engineering provenance only; representative tau=0.02; no scientific tau candidate selected

resume_parity.note: Checkpoint objects and update histories match; independent torch serialization causes differing .pt file byte hashes.

limits: Engineering-only tau=0.02; no supported scientific candidate is implied.
The SCF smoke validates inference/SCF execution from the historical failed tau=0.02 cursor-25 checkpoint and does not establish training stability or chemistry accuracy.
The two-rank CLI proof executes two real updates from the exact 150-update manifest; it is not a full 150-update performance or chemistry result.

objective_definitions.chem: existing Minnesota grouped reaction objective; stoichiometry, database weights, D3 treatment, kcal/mol retained
objective_definitions.exc: existing legacy mRKS integrated Exc target and historical one-addition dispersion treatment; kcal/mol RMSE
objective_definitions.op: h-free variational AO XC operator loss: symmetric-orthogonalized squared Hilbert-Schmidt error divided by nAO

optimizer.name: RAdamW
optimizer.parameter_groups: Linear weights decayed; biases and norm weights excluded

pcd_algorithm.ema_quantity: squared global raw-gradient norm, one scalar per task
pcd_algorithm.epsilon_scope: inside_sqrt; scale invariance is asymptotic for finite eps
pcd_algorithm.infeasible_policy: drop both secondary constraints and use the primary direction
pcd_algorithm.qp: minimize 0.5*||d-g_tilde_chem||^2 subject to g_tilde_j dot d >= tau*||g_tilde_j||^2
pcd_algorithm.zero_primary_policy: return exact zero direction after EMA update

pcd_provenance.paper_citation: Dara Varam and Mohamed I. AlHajri, Not All Objectives Are Born Equal: Priority-Constrained Descent for Hierarchical Multi-Objective Optimization, Transactions on Machine Learning Research, September 2026.

final_tests.notes: No training mathematics changed after d450; final patch registers pcd in SCF CLI.

limitations: Matched training diagnostic panel, not held-out generalization.
All six RAdamW screens rejected; no PCD cursor100 result.
SGD establishes finite-step overshoot; optimizer rotation is not the sole cause.
Two real CPU updates prove engineering parity, not a 150-update result.
AO cache covers 15 of 90 systems; full-90 operator training is not ready.
No production training or Slurm jobs submitted.
